auth_note: Anonymous reads work; POST, PUT, DELETE and some GET requests (such as occurrence downloads) need HTTP Basic auth with a GBIF user account.
rate_limit: No fixed numbers; search APIs may return HTTP 429 depending on server load, and the maximum rate is not guaranteed. Scripts running over 15 minutes should use the download API.
data_license: Per dataset: CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0 (list of supported GBIF licenses)
bulk_access: Occurrence download API (asynchronous, registered users); monthly occurrence exports on AWS, Google GCS and Azure (https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/)
probe_observation: Probe returned JSON starting {"offset":0,"limit":1,"endOfRecords":false,"count":1075,"results":[...] with a Puma genus record.

evidence.quote: Most use of the GBIF API does not require authentication. ... POST, PUT, DELETE and some GET requests require authentication.
Rapid or numerous queries to search APIs may be rate limited , depending on our server load. If this happens, you will receive an HTTP 429 error
we do not guarantee any particular query rate will work
Each month, an export of GBIF occurrence data is uploaded to various cloud computing services.
asynchronous download services to request large, batch downloads

not_established: Cost/pricing statement not found in captured pages (gbif.org/terms returned HTTP 403 challenge from this sandbox, 16 bytes text, so the data user agreement and any licence-of-metadata terms were not captured). Licence is per dataset, no single API-wide licence established. Numeric rate limit not documented.
